fields.subject: SQL Server Type Mapping
fields.trigger: a property is configured with a MapSqlShardKeyAttribute constructor overload
fields.response: represent a supplied shardIdName as a SQL SmallInt column mapping with isRequired false and forward recordIdName to the base shard-key-mapping configuration; the three-argument (shardIdName, recordIdName, childIdName) overload forwards childIdName as the child, grandchild, and great-grandchild identifier name, while every overload that accepts grandChildIdName or greatGrandChildIdName as its own parameter forwards each supplied name only to its own corresponding identifier slot, leaving a deeper slot null when no name is supplied for it
fields.postcondition: an overload that omits isRecordIdentifier configures it as true, and an overload that supplies isRecordIdentifier preserves the given value
